draftBefore.emotion: focused and quiet, sitting at a desk with an open book
notes: Belajar comes from the root ajar (teaching/instruction) with the prefix ber-. It is the standard word for studying a subject or putting time into learning something.
Do not confuse it with mempelajari, which is a transitive verb meaning to study a specific topic or subject in depth with a direct object.

senses.definition: To spend time studying or acquiring knowledge.
